parts.name: Translation Panel (Right Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding glass panel of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting aluminum or PVC frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally along the track, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel (Left Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding glass panel of the window, made of glass and framed with aluminum or PVC.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the second movable section of the window, allowing for flexible opening configurations.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in the opposite direction of the right panel within the same track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window, made of aluminum, which holds the sliding panels in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the tracks that guide the sliding panels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during window operation.
